original_record.why: The function allocates and activates the orthographic texture-rendered shadow used by a fighter and registers the fighter model as its initial caster.

links.rationale: Canonical local implementation independently supports this relation. original_record.why: The function selects fighter and accessory casters, configures light-relative shadow cameras and stage intensity, and performs the offscreen render that generates each fighter's projected-shadow texture.

links.rationale: Canonical local implementation independently supports this relation. Clears all wrapper bit 2 values; scans GX-link 4 lights preferring flag 0x400 and otherwise last flags&3 candidate, then asserts a light and position. Derives light vectors and marks noLight only for computed distance<0.001. Rebuilds fighter caster lists, sets bits 0 and 3, requests active status, configures camera/intensity and renders where shadow and camera box exist and bit 3 is false. This render gate does not directly require active status or noLight false. Calls local background rectangle only when arg0!=0 and brackets processing with ftDrawCommon_80081200/80081168.
